messages:
natalie: Quick intake — proposal for integrator accreditation pillars. want 5 pillars to align SI enablement: Trainer Certification, Sandbox & Labs access, Joint GTM & Co-sell, Technical Onboarding & Playbooks, Marketplace Badging. feedback?
aj: Love it. can we add "enablement metrics" pillar? e.g., ramp time, first-deal time.
kevin: +1. also need proctoring and lab infra for hands-on certs. who owns labs?
maria: timeline? Q2? we need content deadlines and partner legal review.
sam: I'll own playbooks and tech docs. linking the draft repo: https://redwood.example.com/r/integrator-accred-draft
aj: Suggested success metrics in YAML:
```
metrics:
  - ramp_days: 45
  - first_deal_days: 90
  - partner_engaged_pct: 75
```
kevin: For proctoring we can use proctoring vendor or remote labs. cost estimate ~ $8k/quarter per cohort.
natalie: good notes. action items:
- sam -> playbooks draft by 3/25
- kevin -> lab infra options and cost by 3/30
- aj -> metrics dashboard prototype by 4/5
- maria -> legal checklist + T&Cs by 3/28
Please reply with :thumbsup: when you ack.
onboard-bot: New task created: SI-ACCRED-INTAKE-2026 — assignees sam, kevin, aj, maria
aj: :thumbsup: will start on metrics.
sam: :thumbsup: will add initial playbook outline to repo this afternoon.
maria: ack, adding legal review slot on calendar.
kevin: ack, pinging infra to set up lab sandbox.
natalie: thanks team — will sync with sales ops and product for GTM alignment on Friday.
